eyebrow: Resolving source IDs to surrogate keys
code:
INSERT INTO dw.FactProductSales (...)
SELECT dp.ProductKey, dd.DateKey,
       dt.TerritoryKey, dc.CustomerKey,
       sod.SalesOrderID, sod.SalesOrderDetailID,
       sod.OrderQty, sod.LineTotal
FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail sod
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader soh ON ...
JOIN dw.DimProduct dp ON sod.ProductID = dp.ProductAlternateKey
JOIN dw.DimDate dd ON ...
JOIN dw.DimTerritory dt ON ...
JOIN dw.DimCustomer dc ON ...;
caption: Every join is on an AlternateKey — translating real IDs into warehouse keys.
A mismatch means an INNER JOIN silently dropped a row somewhere.
